axes: 2 x receive antenna (Re, Im interleaved: a0.re, a0.im, a1.re, ...)
input.normalization: each slot divided by its RMS over antennas, symbols and subcarriers (mean |y|^2 = 1)
input.signal: 5G NR PUSCH receive grid after the FFT and before channel estimation; 1 slot, 30 kHz SCS, 24 PRB, 4 Rx antennas

tokens.token: one PRB (12 subcarriers, Re and Im) of one antenna in one OFDM symbol

embedding.method: FactorizedMAE.embedding: encoder on the unmasked grid, mean over all 1344 tokens

pretraining.objective: patch-normalized log-power reconstruction of masked tokens + per-patch scale heads (lambda_enc = lambda_dec = 0.1); the relative-phase and complex heads exist in the module but were not trained (weight 0)
pretraining.mask: keep 7 of 14 OFDM symbols and the same 48 of 96 (antenna, PRB) positions (75% masked)
pretraining.schedule: 0-5k AdamW 3e-4 (1k warm-up, cosine); 5k-40k new AdamW, 500 warm-up to 1e-4, cosine; 40k-200k warm restart, 500 warm-up to 1e-4, cosine to 0
pretraining.corpus: 1,000,000 slots: TR 38.901 UMa / UMi / RMa (250k each, Sionna) + DeepMIMO city_0-19 ray-traced links at 3.5 GHz (250k); 837,288 used for pretraining
